// Initialize when DOM loads document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() { // Filmstrip navigation let currentIndex = 0; const cardsContainer = document.getElementById('cardsContainer'); const progressBar = document.getElementById('progressBar'); const prevBtn = document.getElementById('prevBtn'); const nextBtn = document.getElementById('nextBtn'); // Calculate visible cards and total cards const getVisibleCards = () => { const trackWidth = document.querySelector('.fs-track').offsetWidth; const cardWidth = 280 + 16; // card width + gap return Math.floor(trackWidth / cardWidth); }; const getTotalCards = () => { return document.querySelectorAll('.fs-cards-container .fs-card').length; }; function updateFilmstrip() { const visibleCards = getVisibleCards(); const totalCards = getTotalCards(); const maxIndex = Math.max(0, totalCards - visibleCards); // Clamp currentIndex within bounds currentIndex = Math.max(0, Math.min(currentIndex, maxIndex)); const cardWidth = 280 + 16; // card width + gap const offset = -currentIndex * cardWidth; cardsContainer.style.transform = `translateX(${offset}px)`; // Update progress bar const progress = maxIndex > 0 ? ((currentIndex / maxIndex) * 100) : 100; progressBar.style.width = `${Math.min(100, Math.max(16.66, progress))}%`; // Update button states prevBtn.disabled = currentIndex <= 0; nextBtn.disabled = currentIndex >= maxIndex; // Update button opacity prevBtn.style.opacity = currentIndex <= 0 ? '0.3' : '1'; nextBtn.style.opacity = currentIndex >= maxIndex ? '0.3' : '1'; } prevBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { if (currentIndex > 0) { currentIndex--; updateFilmstrip(); } }); nextBtn.addEventListener('click', () => { const visibleCards = getVisibleCards(); const totalCards = getTotalCards(); const maxIndex = Math.max(0, totalCards - visibleCards); if (currentIndex < maxIndex) { currentIndex++; updateFilmstrip(); } }); // Initialize filmstrip updateFilmstrip();
